item.title: Luke Combs Prioritizes Family Over Trying to Impress in the Music Business
item.description: Luke Combs shares his priorities, balancing family time with a busy career, while pushing back against the music industry's pressure to network for awards and recognition.

item.title: Alabama Women's Basketball Head Coach Kristy Curry Leaving Alabama for USF Opening
item.description: After 12 seasons with the Crimson Tide, Alabama women's basketball head coach Kristy Curry will leave Tuscaloosa to become the head coach at South Florida.

item.title: Alabama Football Hires Oklahoma Analyst as Assistant Defensive Line Coach
item.description: Alabama added one more defensive assistant midway through spring practice, with Trent Simpson joining the Crimson Tide as an assistant defensive line coach from Oklahoma.

item.title: Serious Wrecks Across Tuscaloosa County This Afternoon
item.description: Traffic is a mess this afternoon on I-2059 in West Alabama after a major crash near Vance, with westbound lanes completely blocked and emergency responders on the scene.

item.title: Alabama Tight End Kaleb Edwards Shines Light on Crimson Tide Newcomers at Tight End
item.description: On Tuesday, Alabama tight end Kaleb Edwards had positive notes on Crimson Tide newcomers Josh Ford and Mack Sutter.

item.title: Tuscaloosa Get Ready For This Weekend's Health Fair With DCH
item.description: This Saturday, Snow Hinton Park hosts the fourth DCH Health Fair, featuring healthcare professionals, fun activities for kids, and a healthy cooking demo for the whole family.

item.title: Pauline Love Named New Head Coach For Alabama Women's Basketball Team
item.description: The University of Alabama welcomes Pauline Love as its new women's basketball coach, marking a fresh chapter after Kristy Curry's 13-year tenure. Love brings experience and enthusiasm to the court.

item.title: Country Music's 30 Angriest Songs Ever, Ranked
item.description: Put your dukes up! Here are the 30 angriest country songs of all time.

item.title: West Alabama Welcomes New, Unique Shooting Facility
item.description: Fisher Farms Shooting Ventures has opened in Fosters, offering family-friendly shooting experiences, including skeet shooting, memberships, and future plans for a 3D archery range and special events.

item.title: New Tuscaloosa Police Building Now Open
item.description: Tuscaloosa leaders cut the ribbon on a new police logistics building, adding resources and support to strengthen public safety across the city.

item.title: Alabama Men's Basketball Guard Aden Holloway Indicted on Drug Charges
item.description: Alabama men's basketball guard Aden Holloway has been indicted on drug charges, with the case now moving to circuit court.

item.title: Local Youth Programs Get Boost From Tuscaloosa Grant
item.description: A longtime Tuscaloosa partnership continues as local youth programs receive another boost through a grant supporting kids across West Alabama.

item.title: Dan + Shay Aren’t Sure Fans Are Ready for Their New Song ‘Say So’
item.description: The country duo’s new song “Say So” comes from a deeply personal place — and they’re a little worried about how fans will take it.

item.title: Tuscaloosa Police Department Honored for Crisis Response and Mental Health Training
item.description: The Tuscaloosa Police Department has been recognized for expanding its mental health crisis response training.

item.title: Report: Greensboro Police Officer & Suspect Both Wounded in Hale County Shootout
item.description: A police officer in Hale County, Alabama, was wounded in a shootout with a suspect in a traffic stop Thursday night, according to a report from the Moundville Times.
